BL-1102 — The daemon's bounded shell-out throws on a spawn failure instead of returning one: every caller of daemon_cycle_guard_lib/sh! is one unspawnable binary away from an unhandled IOException, and handoffd's delivery loop has no catch to stop it
What it solves: Filed by the specifier 2026-08-23 from the coder's BL-1071 findings note (follow-up b, backlog/evidence/BL-1071-coder-findings.md on the coder branch): "daemon_cycle_guard_lib/sh! does not catch spawn failure. Every caller of that lib is one unspawnable binary away from the failure mode this whole …
Approval context: One decision needs sign-off, and it is the same trade-off BL-1031 was asked about, pointing the other way. Making a spawn failure a RETURNED result means every existing caller's `(:exit result)` check absorbs it as an ordinary command failure - a missing tmux stops being a loud crash and becomes do…
BL-1102 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1102" (or "reject BL-1102 <reason>") to act.
